source: frozen pre-model overlap audit, A manifests/references, and existing pre-B outcomes
interpretation: String similarity, prompt Jaccard, and coarse AST proxies are descriptive; they do not explain causal transfer.

records.eval_prompt: Read nonnegative n. Maintain the running sum of integers 1 through i. At each i divisible by three, add that running sum to an answer initially 1. Print the answer.
records.eval_reference_normalized: NUMBER ID. INPUT(ID). NUMBER ID=ID. NUMBER ID=ID. LOOP (NUMBER ID=ID TILL ID<=ID, ID++) { ID+=ID. IF (ID%ID==ID) { ID+=ID. } } DISPLAYNL(ID).
records.nearest_train_prompt: Read nonnegative n. For each odd i from 1 through n, add 2*i+1; print the total.
records.nearest_train_code_normalized: NUMBER ID. INPUT(ID). NUMBER ID=ID. LOOP (NUMBER ID=ID TILL ID<=ID, ID++) { IF (ID%ID==ID) { ID+=ID. } } DISPLAYNL(ID*ID+ID).

records.eval_prompt: Read nonnegative n. Start total at 1; from i=1 through n add odd i and subtract even i; print total.
records.eval_reference_normalized: NUMBER ID. INPUT(ID). NUMBER ID=ID. LOOP (NUMBER ID=ID TILL ID<=ID, ID++) { IF (ID%ID==ID) { ID-=ID. } ELSE { ID+=ID. } } DISPLAYNL(ID).
records.nearest_train_prompt: Read nonnegative n. For each odd i from 1 through n, add 2*i+1; print the total.
records.nearest_train_code_normalized: NUMBER ID. INPUT(ID). NUMBER ID=ID. LOOP (NUMBER ID=ID TILL ID<=ID, ID++) { IF (ID%ID==ID) { ID+=ID. } } DISPLAYNL(ID*ID+ID).

records.eval_prompt: Read four pipe-delimited numbers into an array. For each negative entry add its magnitude times its one-based position; then add 1.
records.eval_reference_normalized: IMPORT ID. SENTENCE ID. INPUT(ID). SENTENCE[] ID = ID.ID(ID, "ID"). NUMBER ID = ID.ID(ID[ID]). NUMBER ID = ID.ID(ID[ID]). NUMBER ID = ID.ID(ID[ID]). NUMBER ID = ID.ID(ID[ID]). NUMBER[] ID=[ID,ID,ID,ID]. NUMBER ID=ID. LOOP (NUMBER ID=ID TILL ID<ID, ID++) { IF (ID[ID]<ID) { ID+=(ID-ID[ID])*(ID+ID). } } DISPLAYNL(ID).
records.nearest_train_prompt: Read four pipe-delimited numbers into an array. Sum squares of positive entries and add 1.
records.nearest_train_code_normalized: IMPORT ID. SENTENCE ID. INPUT(ID). SENTENCE[] ID = ID.ID(ID, "ID"). NUMBER ID = ID.ID(ID[ID]). NUMBER ID = ID.ID(ID[ID]). NUMBER ID = ID.ID(ID[ID]). NUMBER ID = ID.ID(ID[ID]). NUMBER[] ID=[ID,ID,ID,ID]. NUMBER ID=ID. LOOP (NUMBER ID=ID TILL ID<ID, ID++) { IF (ID[ID]>ID) { ID+=ID. } } DISPLAYNL(ID+ID).

records.eval_prompt: Read nonnegative n. Maintain the running sum of integers 1 through i. At each i divisible by three, add that running sum to an answer initially 8. Print the answer.
records.eval_reference_normalized: NUMBER ID. INPUT(ID). NUMBER ID=ID. NUMBER ID=ID. LOOP (NUMBER ID=ID TILL ID<=ID, ID++) { ID+=ID. IF (ID%ID==ID) { ID+=ID. } } DISPLAYNL(ID).
records.nearest_train_prompt: Read nonnegative n. For each odd i from 1 through n, add 2*i+8; print the total.
records.nearest_train_code_normalized: NUMBER ID. INPUT(ID). NUMBER ID=ID. LOOP (NUMBER ID=ID TILL ID<=ID, ID++) { IF (ID%ID==ID) { ID+=ID. } } DISPLAYNL(ID*ID+ID).

records.eval_prompt: Read nonnegative n. Start total at 8; from i=1 through n add odd i and subtract even i; print total.
records.eval_reference_normalized: NUMBER ID. INPUT(ID). NUMBER ID=ID. LOOP (NUMBER ID=ID TILL ID<=ID, ID++) { IF (ID%ID==ID) { ID-=ID. } ELSE { ID+=ID. } } DISPLAYNL(ID).

records.eval_prompt: Read four pipe-delimited numbers into an array. For each negative entry add its magnitude times its one-based position; then add 8.
records.eval_reference_normalized: IMPORT ID. SENTENCE ID. INPUT(ID). SENTENCE[] ID = ID.ID(ID, "ID"). NUMBER ID = ID.ID(ID[ID]). NUMBER ID = ID.ID(ID[ID]). NUMBER ID = ID.ID(ID[ID]). NUMBER ID = ID.ID(ID[ID]). NUMBER[] ID=[ID,ID,ID,ID]. NUMBER ID=ID. LOOP (NUMBER ID=ID TILL ID<ID, ID++) { IF (ID[ID]<ID) { ID+=(ID-ID[ID])*(ID+ID). } } DISPLAYNL(ID).

records.eval_reference_normalized: IMPORT ID. SENTENCE ID. INPUT(ID). SENTENCE[] ID = ID.ID(ID, "ID"). NUMBER ID = ID.ID(ID[ID]). NUMBER ID = ID.ID(ID[ID]). NUMBER ID = ID.ID(ID[ID]). NUMBER ID = ID.ID(ID[ID]). IMPORT ID. NUMBER[] ID=[ID,ID,ID,ID]. DISPLAYNL(ID.ID(ID[ID]+ID[ID]-ID[ID]-ID[ID])+ID).
